jamie: T-minus 45 for feature-x quiet-window deploy (22:30 UTC). rolling with small canary then 5m ramp. Who's on smoke and rollback owner?

tanvi: I'll own smoke checks. Can run the quick script and validate 200/200 on health and perf.

mike: I'll be rollback owner. Confirmed I can flip the routing flag and run db revert if needed.

jamie: Thanks. Quick checklist for transparency (pinging @eng-ops if anything missing):
- [x] PRs merged (feature-x, infra-flag)
- [x] canary image built and pushed `registry.redwood/feature-x:canary`
- [x] migration is non-blocking (ran locally)
- [ ] smoke runbook assigned -> tanvi
- [ ] rollback steps documented -> mike

tanvi: smoke runbook (short):
1) curl https://staging.redwood/api/v1/health - expect 200, payload {"ok":true}
2) run `scripts/smoke/quick-gen.sh` against canary (10 reqs) -> check latency p95 < 300ms
3) sample output validation: look for "model_version": "v2.4" in generated json

mike: rollback notes (short):
- toggle feature_x_enabled -> false in config-service (k8s secret): `kubectl patch secret config --patch '{"data":{"feature_x_enabled":"ZmFsc2U="}}'`
- scale down canary deployment: `kubectl scale deploy feature-x-canary --replicas=0`
- if DB migration needed revert using `db/migrations/rollback_2026_03.sql` (ops only)

jamie: ops-bot, can you post the deploy slot and runbook link? :wave:

ops-bot: Deploy slot confirmed: 22:30-22:50 UTC. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/deploys/feature-x-2026-03-22

tanvi: I'll start smoke at +5m after canary is green. If anything fails I'll post ✅ or ✖️ here.

jamie: Approvals: @tanvi (smoke), @mike (rollback) — please react with :thumbsup: when ready.

tanvi: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup: (I have console open and alert hooks ready)

jamie: Great — rolling in 30. Leaving this thread for async status updates. If someone needs to escalate call pager on channel `#eng-oncall`

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled at 22:25 UTC for deploy owners.
